sources: Aron, Norman, Aron, McKenna & Heyman (2000), Couples' shared participation in novel and arousing activities and experienced relationship quality, JPSP 78(2) – experiments: novel/arousing joint task vs mundane task → higher relationship quality.
Gable, Reis, Impett & Asher (2004), What do you do when things go right?, JPSP 87(2) – active-constructive responses to a partner's good news linked to intimacy and satisfaction.

Algoe, Gable & Maisel (2010), It's the little things: Everyday gratitude as a booster shot for romantic relationships, Personal Relationships 17(2) – daily diary: gratitude predicted next-day connection and satisfaction.
